shared_elements: human or humanoid figure with raised/outstretched arms
row of repeated short vertical marks forming a band
animal with elongated neck and head in profile (bird-like / snake-like)
schematic figures arranged in stacked registers
justification: Both surfaces stack schematic figures in loose registers and both include a band of repeated short vertical strokes (oars/crew on A, comb-like teeth on B) plus profile animals and a raised-arm humanoid, which is the most specific correspondence but a very generic one. The subject matter otherwise diverges sharply: A shows a manned boat with a large striding human wielding a hafted implement, while B shows a row of crouching quadrupeds, predatory long-snouted beasts, a bird with a long neck and a snake-like sinuous form, with no boat, no weapon-bearing figure and a far more plastic, volumetric rendering versus A's flat linear silhouettes.
